issue_context.title: WebAssembly inside WebWorkers
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

Cannot import WebAssembly file from a Web Worker in production build.
The generated code contains link to the wasm file in the assets directory, 
but it is not copied to the assets directory resulting in a 404 Error.

This works fine if the wasm file is smaller than 4KB as it inlines the file.

### Reproduction

https://github.com/vigneshpa/vite-wasm-worker-bug

### System Info

```shell
System:
    OS: Linux 5.16 Arch Linux
    CPU: (4) x64 Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-7020U CPU @ 2.30GHz
    Memory: 3.74 GB / 7.63 GB
    Container: Yes
    Shell: 5.8 - /bin/zsh
  Binaries:
    Node: 17.3.0 - /usr/bin/node
    npm: 8.3.1 - /usr/bin/npm
  Browsers:
    Chrome: 97.0.4692.99
    Firefox: 96.0.1
  npmPackages:
    vite: ^2.7.13 => 2.7.13
```


### Used Package Manager

npm

### Logs

_No response_
